# Swarm guide

One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).

```
COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
```

## Data flow (who waits for what)

```
BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
TenderScraper (b0) ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
ErpScraper    (b2) waits results["requirements"] -> queue of catalogue groups; ErpHelper (b1) joins after done.spec
                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
MailScraper   (b3) pass 1 approvals/conditions/technical ──> done.mail_core, pass 2 other release mails ──> done.mail
                   ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
BidSubmitter (b0; TAN via a short browse on b3) ──> results["submission"]
```

Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.

## Files

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, ...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form` |
| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes |
| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |

## How the model browses

The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:

- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator).

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

## Contracts (agree before changing)

Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.

## Local development

```powershell
atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```
`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.

## Time budget (20-minute run)

`SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` (default 480 s, env `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S`): collecting/analysing stops that long before expiry,
then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT, which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry.

## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)

- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.

## Open items

- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
"""
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Website ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
        is already saved, while time allows."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is still missing.")
            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            if out["done"] or self.ctx.time_left() < 120:
                break
        return out

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, and ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec
scraper has released that browser. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Once you know a view's URL pattern you may open the same view for another material "
         "with read_page(url=...).")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions "
        "including the quantity-scale register and every condition record/page (topic 'erp prices <number>'), and "
        "its stock overview down to the storage locations (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 30:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > 20:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return

- Stops a running background task by its ID
- Takes a task_id parameter identifying the task to stop
- To stop an agent-team teammate, pass its agent ID or bare teammate name as task_id
- To stop a background agent spawned with a name, pass that name as task_id

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: submitter   NEEDS: results["bid"], results["brief"]   WRITES: enters the bid on the tender portal, signs
"""Enters the computed bid in the tender portal's submission wizard and signs it with the TAN from the webmail.

The model drives the wizard (browser 0) from the brief's submission instructions and a table of the values to enter;
`fill_form` sets many fields per step. When the wizard asks for the signing TAN the model calls `get_signing_tan`,
which runs a short browse on the mail browser (3) to read the newest TAN mail. Runs even if earlier phases failed:
then every position without data is omitted ("partial submission"), the bid is still signed.
"""
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import ActionResult, browse
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S
from swarm.extract import brief_section
from swarm.sites import site_for


class TanParams(BaseModel):
    requested_at: str = Field(default="", description="when you requested the TAN (as shown), if known")


def bid_table(bid: dict, tender: dict) -> str:
    lines = []
    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
    by_pos = {e["position"]: e for e in answer.get("positions") or []}
    for line in bid.get("lines") or []:
        pos = line["position"]
        if pos not in by_pos:
            lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: OMIT this position (use the omit/skip option for it).")
            continue
        e, disp, req = by_pos[pos], line.get("display") or {}, line.get("required") or {}
        extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {disp[k]}" for k, label in (("base_unit_price", "base price per piece before discount"),
                                                                  ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharges per piece"),
                                                                  ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"),
                                                                  ("rebate_total", "project bonus for the whole position"))
                          if k in disp)
        lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: configuration bore {req.get('bore')}, stroke {req.get('stroke')}, mounting "
                     f"{req.get('mounting')}, certification {req.get('certification')} -> material {e['material_number']}; "
                     f"quantity {e['quantity']} pieces; net unit price {disp.get('unit_price')} EUR; lead time "
                     f"{e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks; breakdown (optional fields): {extra or 'leave empty'}")
    known = {line["position"] for line in bid.get("lines") or []}
    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
        if str(p.get("position")) not in known:
            lines.append(f"- Position {p.get('position')}: OMIT this position.")
    return "\n".join(lines) or "- (no position data: omit every position the form shows)"


@register
class BidSubmitter(Agent):
    phase = Phase.SUBMIT
    browser = 0

    async def run(self) -> None:
        ctx = self.ctx
        bid = ctx.board.get("bid") or {"answer": {"decision": "bid", "positions": []}, "lines": []}
        facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        answer = bid["answer"]
        tender_site = await site_for(ctx, "tender")
        mail_site = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get("mail")
        site = ctx.site(tender_site)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        contact = ctx.board.get("mailbox") or ""
        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime())
        decision = answer.get("decision", "bid")
        goal = (
            f"Website (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}\n\n"
            f"SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE BRIEF:\n{brief_section(ctx.brief, 'Submission', 'Abgabe') or ctx.brief[-2500:]}\n\n"
            f"YOUR JOB: submit exactly ONE signed bid for tender {answer.get('tender_reference') or facts.get('tender_reference')}.\n"
            f"Bidder company: {facts.get('bidder_company')}; VAT id (USt-IdNr.): {facts.get('bidder_vat_id')}"
            f"{'; contact e-mail: ' + contact if contact else ''}.\n"
            f"Decision: {'main offer (bid)' if decision == 'bid' else 'no bid (declaration of non-participation)'}.\n"
            f"Discount percent: {answer.get('discount_percent')}. Net total: {bid.get('total_display', '0,00')} EUR "
            f"(enter numbers in German format exactly as given here).\n"
            f"POSITIONS (the form may ask for them in a different order: always read which position it shows):\n"
            f"{bid_table(bid, ctx.board.get('tender') or {})}\n\n"
            "How to work: log in, accept cookies, open the tender, register interest if needed, open the bid "
            "submission. Close survey popups with their x button. Each step saves only with its continue/next button; "
            "going back clears later steps, so get each step right before continuing. Use fill_form to set many fields "
            "of a step in one action: for cascading selects pass apply_button (the button that applies the selection), "
            "set the configuration first, then material, quantity, prices and lead time, and then_click the continue "
            "button. Check every step's result with read_page when unsure (selects may default to a wrong option). "
            "Acknowledge the tender documents, but tick nothing the brief does not ask for (e.g. own terms). When the "
            "form wants the signing TAN, request it in the portal, then call get_signing_tan and enter the TAN it "
            "returns right away (a TAN is valid only a few minutes; a new request invalidates the old one). Review the "
            "summary and confirm the binding submission (accept the browser dialog). Finish with done once the portal "
            "confirms the submission; report the confirmation/receipt text.")

        def tan_tool(tools):
            @tools.action("Read the newest signing TAN from our webmail (call right after requesting a TAN).",
                          param_model=TanParams)
            async def get_signing_tan(params: TanParams):
                if not mail_site:
                    return ActionResult(error="mail website unknown")
                mail = ctx.site(mail_site)
                mc = mail.get("credentials") or {}
                found: list[dict] = []

                async def keep(rec):
                    found.append(rec)
                    await ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind="mail.tan" if rec["kind"] != "page" else "mail.page",
                                                  site=mail_site, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                                  author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
                job = (f"Website (webmail): {mail['url']}\nLogin: username {mc.get('username')!r}, password "
                       f"{mc.get('password')!r}\n\nYOUR JOB: a signing TAN for tender "
                       f"{answer.get('tender_reference')} was just requested (at {params.requested_at or 'just now'}; "
                       f"this session started {started}). Open the inbox (new TAN mails appear without searching), "
                       "open the NEWEST signing-TAN message for this tender, read_page it, then record kind 'mail.tan' "
                       "with data {\"tan\": \"...\", \"received\": \"...\", \"request\": \"...\"} copied exactly, and "
                       "finish with done stating the TAN.")
                out = await browse(ctx, job, browser=3, site_id=mail_site, on_record=keep, max_steps=10,
                                   author=f"{self.name}.tan", stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S)
                tans = [r["data"].get("tan") for r in found if r["kind"] != "page" and r["data"].get("tan")]
                text = f"TAN: {tans[-1]}" if tans else f"No TAN recorded. Mail agent said: {out['summary'][:300]}"
                return ActionResult(extracted_content=text, long_term_memory=text)

        note = ""
        for attempt in range(3):           # an agent that stopped early (errors) gets another go while time allows
            out = await browse(ctx, goal + note, browser=self.browser, site_id=tender_site, max_steps=60,
                               author=self.name, stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S, extra_tools=tan_tool,
                               max_actions_per_step=5)
            await ctx.board.set("submission", {"summary": out["summary"], "done": out["done"], "steps": out["steps"],
                                               "attempt": attempt + 1})
            self.log.info("submission attempt %d finished (done=%s): %s", attempt + 1, out["done"], out["summary"][:500])
            if out["done"] or ctx.seconds_left() < FINAL_MARGIN_S + 90:
                break
            note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). The browser may be in "
                    "the middle of the wizard: check the current page first and continue from there.")

toolUseResult.originalFile:
# Swarm guide

One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).

```
COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
```

## Data flow (who waits for what)

```
BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
TenderScraper (b0) ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
ErpScraper    (b2) waits results["requirements"] -> queue of catalogue groups; ErpHelper (b1) joins after done.spec
                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
MailScraper   (b3) pass 1 approvals/conditions/technical ──> done.mail_core, pass 2 other release mails ──> done.mail
                   ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
BidSubmitter (b0; TAN via a short browse on b3) ──> results["submission"]
```

Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.

## Files

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, ...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form` |
| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes |
| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |

## How the model browses

The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:

- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator).

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

## Contracts (agree before changing)

Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.

## Local development

```powershell
atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```
`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.

## Time budget (20-minute run)

`SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` (default 480 s, env `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S`): collecting/analysing stops that long before expiry,
then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT, which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry.

## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)

- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.

## Robustness settings (learned from the first sandbox runs)

- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps
  went from 10-75 s to a few seconds and the "invalid JSON / prose reply" failures stop.
- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.

## Open items

- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: erp.page (done.erp), results["requirements"], results["tender"], results["mail"]
# WRITES: results["erp"], results["materials"]
"""Turns the saved ERP pages into materials, price conditions and stock, then matches each position in code:
an ACTIVE material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification all equal the requirement exactly.
A requirement given as usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) gets twice the per-end reserve of the technical release for the
current revision added (amendments were already applied by the requirement analyst).

results["erp"] = {"materials": {no: {...}}, "conditions": [{...}], "stock": {no: {"free": "12", "locations": [...]}}}
results["materials"] = {position: {"material": no | None, "required": {...}, "candidates": [...], "reason": str}}
"""
import asyncio
import re
from decimal import Decimal

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_decimal

MATERIAL_SHAPE = """{"materials": [{"material": "material number", "description": "", "kataloggruppe": "",
  "bore": "", "stroke": "", "pressure": "", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
  "status_code": "as shown", "status_meaning": "meaning from the legend/tooltip", "is_active": true/false,
  "lead_time_stock_weeks": "", "lead_time_production_weeks": "", "pieces_per_carton": "",
  "allocation_mass_g": "allocation/Umlage weight per piece in g", "surcharge_mass_g": "surcharge mass per piece in g",
  "metal_index": "price index code"}]}"""

CONDITION_SHAPE = """{"conditions": [{"material": "", "record": "condition record no./page", "condition_type": "",
  "valid_from": "as shown", "valid_to": "as shown", "currency": "", "fx_key": null,
  "price_unit": "price unit quantity, e.g. 100", "number_format": "e.g. en-US or de-DE if stated",
  "scales": [{"min_qty": "as shown incl. locale marker", "price": "as shown incl. locale marker"}]}]}"""

STOCK_SHAPE = """{"stock": [{"material": "", "plant": "", "location": "", "quantity": "as shown",
  "usable": "true if freely usable (unrestricted), false if blocked/quality inspection/not available"}]}"""

MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION = ("List every ERP material on these pages with all its attributes (merge the tabs of one "
                        "material). is_active is true only if the status legend says released/active (not blocked).")
CONDITION_INSTRUCTION = ("List every price condition record on these pages with all quantity-scale rows. Keep the "
                         "number strings exactly with their locale markers; note the stated number format.")
STOCK_INSTRUCTION = ("List stock quantities per material and storage location shown on these pages. A plant total "
                     "that includes blocked/inspection stock is NOT usable; mark usable=true only for freely usable "
                     "storage-location stock.")


def num(text, locale=None) -> Decimal | None:
    return to_decimal(text, locale)


def same(a, b) -> bool:
    x, y = num(a), num(b)
    if x is not None and y is not None:
        return x == y
    return norm_ref(a) == norm_ref(b) and norm_ref(a) != ""


_NONE = re.compile(r"^(KEINE?|NONE|OHNE|NICHT|N/?A|—|-|–)")


def text_equal(a, b) -> bool:
    """Equal after normalisation; 'none required' and 'none' count as the same (no certification)."""
    x, y = norm_ref(a), norm_ref(b)
    if _NONE.match(x) and _NONE.match(y):
        return True
    return x == y and x != ""


def merge_materials(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}
    for r in rows:
        no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
        if not no:
            continue
        cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip()})
        for k, v in r.items():
            if v not in (None, "", "null") and (cur.get(k) in (None, "") or k == "is_active" and v is False):
                cur[k] = v
    return out


def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
        return stroke
    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))
    match = releases.get(key) if key else None
    if match is None:
        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None


def match_positions(tender: dict, requirements: dict, materials: dict, mail: dict, current: str) -> dict:
    out = {}
    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
        ref = next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), None)
        req = requirements.get(ref) if ref else None
        if not req:
            out[pos] = {"material": None, "reason": f"requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found", "candidates": []}
            continue
        stroke = required_stroke(req, mail, current)
        group = norm_ref(req.get("kataloggruppe"))
        cands = []
        for m in materials.values():
            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
                continue
            ok = (same(m.get("bore"), req.get("bore")) and stroke is not None and num(m.get("stroke")) == stroke
                  and same(m.get("pressure"), req.get("pressure")) and text_equal(m.get("mounting"), req.get("mounting"))
                  and text_equal(m.get("certification"), req.get("certification")))
            if ok:
                active = m.get("is_active")
                cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"),
                              "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
        active = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True]
        unknown = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is None]       # status page not read: better than nothing
        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
        chosen = active or unknown
        out[pos] = {"material": chosen[0]["material"] if chosen else None, "required": required, "candidates": cands,
                    "reason": "exact active match" if active else "exact match, status not read" if unknown else
                    ("only blocked matches" if cands else "no exact match among the ERP records read")}
    return out


@register
class MaterialMatcher(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.erp", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "erp")]
        if not blocks:
            raise RuntimeError("no ERP pages were saved")
        mats, conds, stock_out = await asyncio.gather(
            extract(self.ctx, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION, MATERIAL_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="materials", chunk_size=25_000),
            extract(self.ctx, CONDITION_INSTRUCTION, CONDITION_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="conditions", chunk_size=25_000),
            extract(self.ctx, STOCK_INSTRUCTION, STOCK_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="stock", chunk_size=25_000))
        materials = merge_materials(mats.get("materials") or [])
        stock: dict = {}
        for s in stock_out.get("stock") or []:           # one row per (material, location); a re-read replaces
            stock.setdefault(norm_ref(s.get("material")), {})[norm_ref(s.get("location")) or norm_ref(s.get("plant"))] = s
        for no, rows in list(stock.items()):
            free = sum((num(s.get("quantity")) or Decimal(0) for s in rows.values()
                        if str(s.get("usable")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")), Decimal(0))
            stock[no] = {"free": free, "locations": list(rows.values())}
        erp = {"materials": materials, "conditions": conds.get("conditions") or [],
               "stock": {k: {"free": format(v["free"], "f"), "locations": v["locations"]} for k, v in stock.items()}}
        await self.ctx.board.set("erp", erp)
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements_final", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="mail", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))  # end reserves
        except TimeoutError:
            self.log.warning("matching without final requirements or mail")
        mail =self.ctx.board.get("mail") or {}
        spec = self.ctx.board.get("spec") or {}
        result = match_positions(self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}, self.ctx.board.get("requirements") or {},
                                 materials, mail, spec.get("current", ""))
        await self.ctx.board.set("materials", result)
        self.log.info("materials: %s", {p: (r["material"], r["reason"]) for p, r in result.items()})

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, and ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec
scraper has released that browser. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Once you know a view's URL pattern you may open the same view for another material "
         "with read_page(url=...).")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 30:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > 20:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return

entries.name: mcp__atira__models
entries.description: The models the organizers host for free, whether each is up, and how to call them from your computer through `atira models proxy` (the variables to export). Calls from your computer are free, recorded and never ranked.

entries.name: mcp__atira__run_llm_calls
entries.description: Every model call of a run, one line each: time on the run's clock, latency, queue wait (hosted models), model, status, tokens (cached), cost and id. The header has the time in calls, p50/p95 latency, the most calls at once, failures by status and the hosted models' queue waits. Filter by from/to, model and status (ok, error, all); page with after. About 35 tokens a call.

run_id.description: A run id (run_...) from list_runs, a test run id (reh_...), or a submission id (sub_...: its latest run)

from.description: The earliest start, on the run's clock, as the run page and run_logs show it: mm:ss or h:mm:ss (seconds may have a fraction), 3m20s, or seconds; a minus is before the start. An ISO 8601 time also works.

to.description: The latest start, on the run's clock, as the run page and run_logs show it: mm:ss or h:mm:ss (seconds may have a fraction), 3m20s, or seconds; a minus is before the start. An ISO 8601 time also works.

model.description: Only models whose provider/model contains this, e.g. qwen

after.description: Continue after a call id (c_123), e.g. the previous page's next

content.text:
Hosted models:
  Clef (clef): ready
  Qwen (qwen): ready

In a test or scored run, the sandbox has each model's base URL and key variables set. On your computer:
  atira models proxy        # in its own terminal; keep it running (it uses your atira login)
Then, where your agent runs:
  $env:QWEN_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1'
  $env:QWEN_API_KEY = 'local'
  $env:CLEF_BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/clef'
  $env:CLEF_API_KEY = 'local'
Qwen speaks the OpenAI API: OpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"]).chat.completions.create(model="qwen", messages=[...])
Calls from your computer are free, recorded and never ranked.

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, and ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec
scraper has released that browser. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Once you know a view's URL pattern you may open the same view for another material "
         "with read_page(url=...).")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:

"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page"), in two passes:
1. the sales director's discount approvals (sets done.mail_core when finished),
2. the other release mails the brief names (condition rules, technical release, packaging, delivery, setup pools,
   project bonus, FX, price indices), if time allows (sets done.mail).
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "The mailbox search combines words with AND and shows at most a limited number of hits: search for the exact "
    "tender reference plus ONE topic word at a time (e.g. '<reference> <topic>'). Search the inbox AND the archive "
    "folder (also page through results). Look-alike references (same reference with a suffix) and other tenders do "
    "not count, but drafts, previews and superseded mails look similar: read each candidate message.\n"
    "For every message whose subject or text names this tender's reference and the topic, open it and read_page it "
    "with topic '<topic> mail' (read_page also reads collapsed or locked parts of the message, so you do not need to "
    "unlock anything). Skip signing-TAN mails.")


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 26
    hints = ("Webmail habits: a cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close them, do not follow their links); "
             "an inbox and an archive folder; paged result lists; message headers (sender, date) are in a collapsed "
             "'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts = await self.wait_brief()
            topics = [t for t in (facts.get("mail_topics") or []) if t]
            first = (f"Find the discount approvals for this tender (sender: {facts.get('director_sender') or 'the sales director'}). "
                     f"Topic words to try: {facts.get('discount_topic') or 'Rabatt'}, Rabattfreigabe.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\n"
                     "Then also do the same for the condition-rule mails (Konditionsregeln) and the technical release "
                     "mails (Technikfreigabe) if they exist. Finish with done.")
            out = await self.browse_until_done(first, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts          # the brief facts may have arrived meanwhile
            topics = [t for t in (facts.get("mail_topics") or []) if t]
            rest =[t for t in topics if t.lower() not in ("rabatt", "rabattfreigabe", "konditionsregeln", "technikfreigabe")]
            if rest and self.ctx.time_left() > 150:
                second = (f"Find the release mails for this tender on these topics, one search per topic: {', '.join(rest)}.\n"
                          f"{SEARCH_RULES}\nFinish with done.")
                out = await self.browse(second, max_steps=30)
                await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary2", out["summary"])
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, and ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec
scraper has released that browser. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Save steps: once you have seen the links of a record's tabs/registers, read them all "
         "with ONE read_page(urls=[...]) call, and use the same URL pattern for the next candidate.")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 30:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > 20:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1
    after = "done.spec"

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=self.after, timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return


@register
class ErpHelperTender(ErpHelper):
    """Third ERP worker on browser 0, after the tender scraper is done with it (the submitter needs it only later)."""
    browser = 0
    after = "done.tender"

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: webmail (role "mail")
"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page"), in two passes:
1. the sales director's discount approvals (sets done.mail_core when finished),
2. the other release mails the brief names (condition rules, technical release, packaging, delivery, setup pools,
   project bonus, FX, price indices), if time allows (sets done.mail).
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "The mailbox search combines words with AND and shows at most a limited number of hits: search for the exact "
    "tender reference plus ONE topic word at a time (e.g. '<reference> <topic>'). Search the inbox AND the archive "
    "folder (also page through results). Look-alike references (same reference with a suffix) and other tenders do "
    "not count, but drafts, previews and superseded mails look similar: read each candidate message.\n"
    "For every message whose subject or text names this tender's reference and the topic, read it with read_page and "
    "topic '<topic> mail' - read several selected messages at once with read_page(urls=[their links]) - (read_page "
    "also reads collapsed or locked parts of a message, so you do not need to unlock anything). Skip signing-TAN mails.")


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 26
    hints = ("Webmail habits: a cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close them, do not follow their links); "
             "an inbox and an archive folder; paged result lists; message headers (sender, date) are in a collapsed "
             "'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts = await self.wait_brief()
            topics = [t for t in (facts.get("mail_topics") or []) if t]
            first = (f"Find the discount approvals for this tender (sender: {facts.get('director_sender') or 'the sales director'}). "
                     f"Topic words to try: {facts.get('discount_topic') or 'Rabatt'}, Rabattfreigabe.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\n"
                     "Then also do the same for the condition-rule mails (Konditionsregeln) and the technical release "
                     "mails (Technikfreigabe) if they exist. Finish with done.")
            out = await self.browse_until_done(first, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts          # the brief facts may have arrived meanwhile
            topics = [t for t in (facts.get("mail_topics") or []) if t]
            rest =[t for t in topics if t.lower() not in ("rabatt", "rabattfreigabe", "konditionsregeln", "technikfreigabe")]
            if rest and self.ctx.time_left() > 150:
                second = (f"Find the release mails for this tender on these topics, one search per topic: {', '.join(rest)}.\n"
                          f"{SEARCH_RULES}\nFinish with done.")
                out = await self.browse(second, max_steps=30)
                await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary2", out["summary"])
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

@tools.action("Read the full text of the current page (or of `url`), incl. iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips; "
                  "optionally follow `next_page_link` through all pages; `topic` saves it as evidence.",
                  param_model=ReadParams)
    async def read_one(target: str | None, params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession) -> tuple[str, str]:
        if target:
            await browser_session.navigate_to(target)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
        pages = [await read_current_page(browser_session)]
        if params.next_page_link:
            for _ in range(max(0, min(params.max_pages, 20) - 1)):
                if await _evaluate(browser_session, NEXT_JS, params.next_page_link) != "clicked":
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(1.2)
                text = await read_current_page(browser_session)
                if text == pages[-1]:
                    break
                pages.append(text)
        text = "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n".join(pages)
        if params.topic:
            title = await browser_session.get_current_page_title()
            await emit({"kind": "page", "data": {"topic": params.topic, "url": url, "title": title,
                                                 "pages": len(pages), "text": text[:10 * PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT]},
                        "source": url, "note": "", "site": site_id, "author": author})
        return url, text

    async def read_page(params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
        current = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
        wanted = [u for u in ([params.url] if params.url else []) + list(params.urls or []) if u][:12]

async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, site_id: str = "", on_record=None, max_steps: int = 40,
                 hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False, stop_reserve: float | None = None,
                 extra_tools=None, max_actions_per_step: int = 4) -> dict:
    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.

    Screenshots are off by default (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page`
    already reads canvas labels and hidden text. `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this many seconds left
    (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)`
    may register more actions. Pages read with a `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
    """
    records: list[dict] = []
    tools = Tools()
    reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S if stop_reserve is None else stop_reserve

    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
        records.append(rec)
        if on_record:
            await on_record(rec)

    @tools.action("Save a fact you found (kept even if you run out of time).", param_model=RecordParams)
    async def record(params: RecordParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
        await emit({"kind": params.kind, "data": params.data, "source": params.source or url, "note": params.note,
                    "site": site_id, "author": author})
        return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"recorded {params.kind}")

    async def read_one(target: str | None, params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession) -> tuple[str, str]:
        if target:
            await browser_session.navigate_to(target)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)

"""The swarm framework against fakes: blackboard, JSON parsing, phase orchestration, failure isolation."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from swarm import Agent, Blackboard, Evidence, Phase  # noqa: E402
from swarm import orchestrator  # noqa: E402
from swarm.llm import parse_json  # noqa: E402

TASK = {"brief": "b", "access": [{"siteId": "erp", "url": "http://x", "credentials": {}}],
        "submission": {"kind": "site"}, "expires_at": None}


class BoardTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_post_query_and_wait(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        waiter = asyncio.create_task(board.wait_for(kind="a.b", timeout=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        await board.post(Evidence("a.b", "erp", {"x": 1}, source="u"))
        self.assertEqual((await waiter)[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(len(board.query("a", prefix=True)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(board.query("a.b", site="mail"), [])

    async def test_dump_and_load_round_trip(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {"x": 1}))
        await board.set("r", [1])
        path = Path(__file__).parent / "_board.json"
        try:
            board.dump(path)
            again = Blackboard.load(path)
        finally:
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.assertEqual(again.evidence[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(again.get("r"), [1])


class ParseJson(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fenced_and_chatty(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_json('Sure!\n```json\n{"a": [1, 2]}\n```'), {"a": [1, 2]})

    def test_garbage_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_json("no json here")


def make_agents(order):
    class Boom(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self): raise RuntimeError("boom")

    class Collect(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("collect")
            await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {}))

    class Analyze(Agent):
        phase = Phase.ANALYZE
        async def run(self):
            order.append(f"analyze sees {len(self.ctx.board.query('k'))}")

    class Submit(Agent):
        phase = Phase.SUBMIT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("submit")
            await self.ctx.board.set("answer", {"ok": True})

    return [Submit, Analyze, Boom, Collect]


class Orchestration(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def run_with(self, classes, task=TASK, env=None):
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "discover", lambda: classes):
            return await orchestrator.run_swarm(task, None, scored=True, env=env or {})

    async def test_phases_run_in_order_and_a_failure_does_not_stop_the_rest(self):
        order = []
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "analyze sees 1", "submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})

    async def test_only_filter(self):
        order = []
        await self.run_with(make_agents(order), env={"SWARM_ONLY": "Collect,Submit"})
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "submit"])

    async def test_out_of_time_skips_work_but_still_submits(self):
        order = []
        late = {**TASK, "expires_at": (time.time() + 100) * 1000}   # inside the submit margin
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order), task=late)
        self.assertEqual(order, ["submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})


class BrowserUseWiring(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_task_sites_are_allowed_and_telemetry_is_off(self):
        import os
        from swarm import browser_agent
        task = {"access": [{"url": "https://a.example/x?y=1"}, {"url": "http://b.example:8080/"}, {"url": ""}]}
        self.assertEqual(browser_agent.allowed_domains(task), ["https://a.example", "http://b.example:8080"])
        for flag in ("ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY", "BROWSER_USE_CLOUD_SYNC", "BROWSER_USE_VERSION_CHECK"):
            self.assertEqual(os.environ[flag], "false")


class RealAgentsImport(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_agent_module_imports_and_registers(self):
        names = {c.__name__ for c in orchestrator.discover()}
        self.assertTrue({"TenderScraper", "SpecScraper", "ErpScraper", "MailScraper", "BidSubmitter"} <= names)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
