# Swarm guide

One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).

```
COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
```

## Data flow (who waits for what)

```
BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
TenderScraper (b0) ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
ErpScraper    (b2) waits results["requirements"] -> queue of catalogue groups; ErpHelper (b1) joins after done.spec
                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
MailScraper   (b3) pass 1 approvals/conditions/technical ──> done.mail_core, pass 2 other release mails ──> done.mail
                   ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
BidSubmitter (b0; TAN via a short browse on b3) ──> results["submission"]
```

Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.

## Files

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, ...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form` |
| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes |
| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |

## How the model browses

The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:

- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator).

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

## Contracts (agree before changing)

Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.

## Local development

```powershell
atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```
`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.

## Time budget (20-minute run)

`SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` (default 480 s, env `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S`): collecting/analysing stops that long before expiry,
then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT, which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry.

## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)

- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.

- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps

- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.

| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |

Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.

- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec scraper
has released it and ErpHelperTender on browser 0 after the tender scraper. results["done.erp"] is set when every item
has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Save steps: once you have seen the links of a record's tabs/registers, read them all "
         "with ONE read_page(urls=[...]) call, and use the same URL pattern for the next candidate.")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > 30:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > 20:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1
    after = "done.spec"

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=self.after, timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return


@register
class ErpHelperTender(ErpHelper):
    """Third ERP worker on browser 0, after the tender scraper is done with it (the submitter needs it only later)."""
    browser = 0
    after = "done.tender"

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
"""
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Website ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
        is already saved, while time allows."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is still missing.")
            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            if out["done"] or self.ctx.time_left() < 120:
                break
        return out

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
"""
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Website ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
        is already saved, while time allows."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is still missing.")
            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            if out["done"] or self.ctx.seconds_left() - kwargs.get("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S) < 120:
                break
        return out

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec scraper
has released it and ErpHelperTender on browser 0 after the tender scraper. results["done.erp"] is set when every item
has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 120    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; for a slider gate press the End key "
         "on the slider or drag it fully right, and tick the checkbox); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Save steps: once you have seen the links of a record's tabs/registers, read them all "
         "with ONE read_page(urls=[...]) call, and use the same URL pattern for the next candidate.")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:   # stop browsing early enough for the matcher to extract and match before collecting ends
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2,
                                             stop_reserve=SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_TIME_S)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1
    after = "done.spec"

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=self.after, timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return


@register
class ErpHelperTender(ErpHelper):
    """Third ERP worker on browser 0, after the tender scraper is done with it (the submitter needs it only later)."""
    browser = 0
    after = "done.tender"

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    return board.get("answer")

"""The swarm framework against fakes: blackboard, JSON parsing, phase orchestration, failure isolation."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from swarm import Agent, Blackboard, Evidence, Phase  # noqa: E402
from swarm import orchestrator  # noqa: E402
from swarm.llm import parse_json  # noqa: E402

TASK = {"brief": "b", "access": [{"siteId": "erp", "url": "http://x", "credentials": {}}],
        "submission": {"kind": "site"}, "expires_at": None}


class BoardTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_post_query_and_wait(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        waiter = asyncio.create_task(board.wait_for(kind="a.b", timeout=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        await board.post(Evidence("a.b", "erp", {"x": 1}, source="u"))
        self.assertEqual((await waiter)[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(len(board.query("a", prefix=True)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(board.query("a.b", site="mail"), [])

    async def test_dump_and_load_round_trip(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {"x": 1}))
        await board.set("r", [1])
        path = Path(__file__).parent / "_board.json"
        try:
            board.dump(path)
            again = Blackboard.load(path)
        finally:
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.assertEqual(again.evidence[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(again.get("r"), [1])


class ParseJson(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fenced_and_chatty(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_json('Sure!\n```json\n{"a": [1, 2]}\n```'), {"a": [1, 2]})

    def test_garbage_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_json("no json here")


def make_agents(order):
    class Boom(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self): raise RuntimeError("boom")

    class Collect(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("collect")
            await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {}))

    class Analyze(Agent):
        phase = Phase.ANALYZE
        async def run(self):
            order.append(f"analyze sees {len(self.ctx.board.query('k'))}")

    class Submit(Agent):
        phase = Phase.SUBMIT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("submit")
            await self.ctx.board.set("answer", {"ok": True})

    return [Submit, Analyze, Boom, Collect]


class Orchestration(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def run_with(self, classes, task=TASK, env=None):
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "discover", lambda: classes):
            return await orchestrator.run_swarm(task, None, scored=True, env=env or {})

    async def test_phases_run_in_order_and_a_failure_does_not_stop_the_rest(self):
        order = []
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "analyze sees 1", "submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})

    async def test_only_filter(self):
        order = []
        await self.run_with(make_agents(order), env={"SWARM_ONLY": "Collect,Submit"})
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "submit"])

    async def test_out_of_time_skips_work_but_still_submits(self):
        order = []
        late = {**TASK, "expires_at": (time.time() + 100) * 1000}   # inside the submit margin
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order), task=late)
        self.assertEqual(order, ["submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})


class BrowserUseWiring(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_task_sites_are_allowed_and_telemetry_is_off(self):
        import os
        from swarm import browser_agent
        task = {"access": [{"url": "https://a.example/x?y=1"}, {"url": "http://b.example:8080/"}, {"url": ""}]}
        self.assertEqual(browser_agent.allowed_domains(task), ["https://a.example", "http://b.example:8080"])
        for flag in ("ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY", "BROWSER_USE_CLOUD_SYNC", "BROWSER_USE_VERSION_CHECK"):
            self.assertEqual(os.environ[flag], "false")


class BrowseTools(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_our_actions_are_registered_and_helpers_are_not(self):
        from swarm import browser_agent
        tools = browser_agent.build_tools(None, "erp", "t", None)
        names = set(tools.registry.registry.actions)
        self.assertTrue({"record", "read_page", "fill_form"} <= names)
        self.assertNotIn("read_one", names)


class RealAgentsImport(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_agent_module_imports_and_registers(self):
        names = {c.__name__ for c in orchestrator.discover()}
        self.assertTrue({"TenderScraper", "SpecScraper", "ErpScraper", "MailScraper", "BidSubmitter"} <= names)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Your agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

The kit only does the plumbing: run.py reads the run and submits an answer, browsers.py attaches to the run's
browsers, models.py calls the hosted Qwen and Clef. Everything else is yours to build, in `solve` below.
Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md, $API/docs/run-contract.md, and the rules: $API/docs/fair-play.md
"""
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import sys

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import run as contract
from swarm.orchestrator import run_swarm


async def solve(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool) -> dict | None:
    """Runs the swarm (see docs/SWARM.md). Agents live in agents/; the orchestrator runs them phase by phase.

    For an "api" submission the swarm leaves the answer in board.results["answer"]; for a "site" submission the
    submit agent enters it on the website and the result is None.
    """
    return await run_swarm(task, playwright, scored)


async def main() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright, scored=bool(token))
    if answer is None:
        print("No answer to submit: build your agent in solve() in agent.py", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

The fixed pipeline is now running on two fronts: a new sandbox test run, and a local test of the ERP stage on saved pages. Neither has produced a full bid yet.

- **Sandbox test run:** `run_354961221455dd45` (https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/runs/run_354961221455dd45). I'm watching its log and will report when the bid is computed and signed. The previous run `run_4dee5ed99e8a16c4` is cancelled as you asked. I also cancelled two later test runs because they were running code I had since fixed.
- **Local test:** the ERP agent is browsing the ERP live, with the analysts working on pages I collected from the scouting sites. It is past the ERP's slider-and-receipt gate and searching materials.

**What was broken, and the fixes:**
- **Steps stalling for 30 s:** browser-use took a screenshot every step and the screenshot stalled in the sandbox. Screenshots are now off; the page reader still captures text drawn on canvas.
- **Unparseable model replies:** the model sometimes answered in prose instead of the expected JSON, and that step was lost. Replies are now forced to JSON, for browsing and for extraction.
- **Wrong 01.05 quantity:** the model treated "a newer answer replaces an older one" as "the older one was withdrawn", which would have discarded the valid 26-set answer. Only answers that explicitly withdraw another count as withdrawals now.
- **Tender scraper ran out of steps before the Q&A:** that left quantities without the Q&A changes. It now reads the Q&A first, and the tender and spec scrapers each re-read anything still missing at the end.
- **Mail extraction empty in the sandbox:** the mail reading pane was a frame that hadn't loaded, so pages were saved without the message text. The page reader now says so and tells the model which link to open.
- **Wrong no-bid risk:** a material whose status page wasn't read counted as blocked, which could have forced a no-bid. It now counts as unknown and is still used.
- **Missing stroke matches:** the matcher didn't wait for the technical release mail, so cylinders whose stroke needs the end reserves added found no match.
- **Certification mismatch:** "keine gefordert" in the spec and "Keine" in the ERP now count as the same.
- **A bug I introduced:** a decorator I misplaced while editing broke the page reader in the second cancelled run. It's fixed and a unit test now guards it.

**Speed changes:**
- One `read_page` call can now read several selected pages at once, such as all tabs of an ERP record or several mails.
- ERP work is shared across three browsers and covers only the catalogue groups that tender positions actually use. That saves one of the five groups on the public data.
- The ERP search starts as soon as the requirement table is saved.
- ERP stops early enough for the material matcher to finish.
- The submitter gets 9 minutes instead of 8 and retries if it stops before signing.

**Checked against the real sites:**
- The quantity analysis gives the right quantities: 01.01 = 25, and 01.05 = 26 sets, which is 130 pieces at 5 per set.
- The discount analysis picks the director's 5% approval from 9 valid mails out of 14.
- The current spec revision (R-6156) and all 5 requirements are found.
- I walked the bid wizard with the form-filling helper up to the TAN step without submitting. Its steps:
  1. Bidder data.
  2. Offer type. The default is the wrong one.
  3. One step per position, in shuffled order.
  4. Discount and net total.
  5. Acknowledge the documents. An "own terms" box must stay unticked, or the portal rejects the step.
  6. Summary, TAN request and submit.

**Not yet confirmed:**
- Whether the ERP stage finishes in time inside a 20-minute scored run.
- The full signed submission. That needs the current test run to get through.
- The hosted Qwen is congested: the last run's calls waited about 10 s in its queue (median), which slows every browser step.

41 unit tests pass. Nothing is committed yet; the changes are on the `tender_portal` branch.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Atira EHL challenge "rfq" v6. The bid is entered in the tender-portal wizard and signed with a TAN from the webmail (`submission.kind = site`).
   - The run brief (`task["brief"]`) contains:
     - the tender reference, scenario date, bidder company and VAT id;

     - the submission section (Teilnahme bekunden, Hauptangebot/Verzichtserklärung, German number format, TAN valid 5 min, a new TAN request invalidates the old one, confirm in the browser dialog).
   - The swarm is one asyncio process with a Blackboard (Evidence + results), an orchestrator with phases (COLLECT → ANALYZE → VERIFY → COMPUTE → SUBMIT), and agents in `agents/` registered with `@register`.

     - Hosted Qwen queue waits are about 10 s at p50.
   - Pattern: the model selects pages → a helper extracts the full text (iframes, closed details, tooltips, canvas aria-labels, zero-width characters stripped, decoys with hidden/aria-hidden skipped) → saved as Evidence `<role>.page` → analysts extract JSON shapes with the LLM → rules are applied in deterministic code (Decimal, HALF_UP).

"""Your agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

The kit only does the plumbing: run.py reads the run and submits an answer, browsers.py attaches to the run's
browsers, models.py calls the hosted Qwen and Clef. Everything else is yours to build, in `solve` below.
Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md, $API/docs/run-contract.md, and the rules: $API/docs/fair-play.md
"""
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import sys

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import run as contract
from swarm.orchestrator import run_swarm


async def solve(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool) -> dict | None:
    """Runs the swarm (see docs/SWARM.md). Agents live in agents/; the orchestrator runs them phase by phase.

    For an "api" submission the swarm leaves the answer in board.results["answer"]; for a "site" submission the
    submit agent enters it on the website and the result is None.
    """
    return await run_swarm(task, playwright, scored)


async def main() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright, scored=bool(token))
    if answer is None:
        print("Nothing to post: the bid is entered and signed on the website by the submitter agent"
              if task["submission"].get("kind") == "site" else "No answer was produced", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""The swarm framework against fakes: blackboard, JSON parsing, phase orchestration, failure isolation."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from swarm import Agent, Blackboard, Evidence, Phase  # noqa: E402
from swarm import orchestrator  # noqa: E402
from swarm.llm import parse_json  # noqa: E402

TASK = {"brief": "b", "access": [{"siteId": "erp", "url": "http://x", "credentials": {}}],
        "submission": {"kind": "api"}, "expires_at": None}


class BoardTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_post_query_and_wait(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        waiter = asyncio.create_task(board.wait_for(kind="a.b", timeout=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        await board.post(Evidence("a.b", "erp", {"x": 1}, source="u"))
        self.assertEqual((await waiter)[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(len(board.query("a", prefix=True)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(board.query("a.b", site="mail"), [])

    async def test_dump_and_load_round_trip(self):
        board = Blackboard()
        await board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {"x": 1}))
        await board.set("r", [1])
        path = Path(__file__).parent / "_board.json"
        try:
            board.dump(path)
            again = Blackboard.load(path)
        finally:
            path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.assertEqual(again.evidence[0].data, {"x": 1})
        self.assertEqual(again.get("r"), [1])


class ParseJson(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fenced_and_chatty(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_json('Sure!\n```json\n{"a": [1, 2]}\n```'), {"a": [1, 2]})

    def test_garbage_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_json("no json here")


def make_agents(order):
    class Boom(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self): raise RuntimeError("boom")

    class Collect(Agent):
        phase = Phase.COLLECT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("collect")
            await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {}))

    class Analyze(Agent):
        phase = Phase.ANALYZE
        async def run(self):
            order.append(f"analyze sees {len(self.ctx.board.query('k'))}")

    class Submit(Agent):
        phase = Phase.SUBMIT
        async def run(self):
            order.append("submit")
            await self.ctx.board.set("answer", {"ok": True})

    return [Submit, Analyze, Boom, Collect]


class Orchestration(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def run_with(self, classes, task=TASK, env=None):
        with patch.object(orchestrator, "discover", lambda: classes):
            return await orchestrator.run_swarm(task, None, scored=True, env=env or {})

    async def test_phases_run_in_order_and_a_failure_does_not_stop_the_rest(self):
        order = []
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order))
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "analyze sees 1", "submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})

    async def test_site_submission_returns_nothing_to_post(self):
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents([]), task={**TASK, "submission": {"kind": "site"}})
        self.assertIsNone(answer)

    async def test_only_filter(self):
        order = []
        await self.run_with(make_agents(order), env={"SWARM_ONLY": "Collect,Submit"})
        self.assertEqual(order, ["collect", "submit"])

    async def test_out_of_time_skips_work_but_still_submits(self):
        order = []
        late = {**TASK, "expires_at": (time.time() + 100) * 1000}   # inside the submit margin
        answer = await self.run_with(make_agents(order), task=late)
        self.assertEqual(order, ["submit"])
        self.assertEqual(answer, {"ok": True})


class BrowserUseWiring(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_task_sites_are_allowed_and_telemetry_is_off(self):
        import os
        from swarm import browser_agent
        task = {"access": [{"url": "https://a.example/x?y=1"}, {"url": "http://b.example:8080/"}, {"url": ""}]}
        self.assertEqual(browser_agent.allowed_domains(task), ["https://a.example", "http://b.example:8080"])
        for flag in ("ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY", "BROWSER_USE_CLOUD_SYNC", "BROWSER_USE_VERSION_CHECK"):
            self.assertEqual(os.environ[flag], "false")


class BrowseTools(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_our_actions_are_registered_and_helpers_are_not(self):
        from swarm import browser_agent
        tools = browser_agent.build_tools(None, "erp", "t", None)
        names = set(tools.registry.registry.actions)
        self.assertTrue({"record", "read_page", "fill_form"} <= names)
        self.assertNotIn("read_one", names)


class RealAgentsImport(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_agent_module_imports_and_registers(self):
        names = {c.__name__ for c in orchestrator.discover()}
        self.assertTrue({"TenderScraper", "SpecScraper", "ErpScraper", "MailScraper", "BidSubmitter"} <= names)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    if (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind", "api") != "api":
        log.info("answer (entered on the website): %s", board.get("answer"))
        return None                      # a "site" submission was entered by the submitter agent
    return board.get("answer")

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
Items sit in a shared queue; ErpScraper (browser 2) works on it, ErpHelper joins on browser 1 once the spec scraper
has released it and ErpHelperTender on browser 0 after the tender scraper. results["done.erp"] is set when every item
has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 120    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; a slider/robot gate can be passed "
         "with ONE fill_form: slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and the "
         "confirmation checkbox, then_click the continue button); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
         "login page appears. Save steps: once you have seen the links of a record's tabs/registers, read them all "
         "with ONE read_page(urls=[...]) call, and use the same URL pattern for the next candidate.")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self) -> None:
        queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
        while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:   # stop browsing early enough for the matcher to extract and match before collecting ends
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2,
                                             stop_reserve=SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_TIME_S)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, and open the "
                                  "material search help of the material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. "
                                  "Finish with done once the search form is open.", max_steps=12)
            await self.work()
        finally:                                    # wait for the helper's last item, then release the analysts
            while self.ctx.shared.get("erp.pending", 0) > 0 and self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)


@register
class ErpHelper(ErpScraper):
    """Second ERP worker on browser 1, after the spec scraper is done with it."""
    browser = 1
    after = "done.spec"

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key=self.after, timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            await self.work()
        except TimeoutError:
            return


@register
class ErpHelperTender(ErpHelper):
    """Third ERP worker on browser 0, after the tender scraper is done with it (the submitter needs it only later)."""
    browser = 0
    after = "done.tender"

## atira
Atira Challenges: debug your team's agent system runs. Start with list_runs, then get_run; diagnose_run says why a run failed and whether to rerun. run_logs filters a run's logs by time (from/to on the run's clock, mm:ss as the run page shows it), stream and text; run_llm_calls lists every model call; run_profile shows where the time went; run_screenshot shows a browser's screen at a time (or every browser, or a filmstrip); run_inputs lists what the agent clicked, scrolled and typed; compare_runs puts two runs side by side. run_package shows the package a run or submission used (agent.json and its files) and saves it with out. test_run starts a test run from a folder; wait_for_run waits for it. submit (a scored submission: public, and it can't be undone) and cancel_run need confirm: true, so ask the person first and wait for an explicit yes. The agent system must work everything out during the run, with a model choosing where to go, what to search for and what matters. Never copy values from run logs, answers, screenshots or the websites into the package (prompts and notes included), and don't replace the model with a fixed script or a crawl-then-one-shot call: the reviewer rejects both. Rules at a glance: https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/fair-play.md

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>

<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.
